i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-x\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            nx = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-y\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            ny = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-z\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            nz = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-i\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            iterations = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    if (ny == 0) ny = nx;\n    if (nz == 0) nz = nx;\n    \n    printf(\"3D Stencil Benchmark\\n\");\n    printf(\"Grid size: %zu x %zu x %zu\\n\", nx, ny, nz);\n    printf(\"Iterations: %d\\n\", iterations);\n    printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n    \n    size_t gridSize = nx * ny * nz;\n    \n    // Allocate grids (double buffering)\n    std::vector<Real> grid1(gridSize);\n    std::vector<Real> grid2(gridSize);\n    \n    // Initialize\n    printf(\"Initializing grid...\\n\");\n    initializeGrid(grid1, nx, ny, nz);\n    \n    // Run stencil iterations\n    printf(\"Running stencil computation...\\n\");\n    auto start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    \n    for (int iter = 0; iter < iterations; ++iter) {\n        if (iter % 2 == 0) {\n            stencilIteration(grid1, grid2, nx, ny, nz);\n        } else {\n            stencilIteration(grid2, grid1, nx, ny, nz);\n        }\n    }\n    \n    auto end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    auto duration = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(end - start);\n    \n    printf(\"Computation time: %ld ms\\n\", duration.count());\n    \n    // Calculate performance metrics\n    double cellUpdates = (double)((nx-2) * (ny-2) * (nz-2)) * iterations;\n    double mcups = cellUpdates / (duration.count() / 1000.0) / 1e6; z < nz; ++z) {\n        for (size_t y = 0; y < ny; ++y) {\n            for (size_t x = 0; x < nx; ++x) {\n                const size_t idx = idx3(x, y, z, nx, ny);\n                grid[idx] = (idx % 19) * 1.0;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// 7-point stencil computation\nvoid stencilIteration(const std::vector<Real>& input, \n                      std::vector<Real>& output,\n                      const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {\n    // Process interior points (not on boundaries)\n    for (size_t z = 1; z < nz - 1; ++z) {\n        for (size_t y = 1; y < ny - 1; ++y) {\n            for (size_t x = 1; x < nx - 1; ++x) {\n                const size_t idx = idx3(x, y, z, nx, ny);\n                \n                const Real center = input[idx];\n                const Real left = input[idx3(x-1, y, z, nx, ny)];\n                const Real right = input[idx3(x+1, y, z, nx, ny)];\n                const Real front = input[idx3(x, y-1, z, nx, ny)];\n                const Real back = input[idx3(x, y+1, z, nx, ny)];\n                const Real bottom = input[idx3(x, y, z-1, nx, ny)];\n                const Real top = input[idx3(x, y, z+1, nx, ny)];\n                \n                // Simple averaging stencil\n                output[idx] = (center + left + right + front + back + bottom + top) / 7.0;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // Copy boundary values\n    for (size_t z = 0; {"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1793060294443,"sessionID":"ses_e8548239cffes90HT8MftQy6mQ","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"toolu_01NvXUEjdxAiiwBc9oNiroQz","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"filePath":"/run/llm-eval/state/tmp/opencode/orig/stencil3d/stencil3d.cpp","content":"#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nusing Real = double;\n\ninline constexpr size_t idx3(const size_t x, const size_t y, const size_t z, const size_t nx, const size_t ny) noexcept {\n    return z * (nx * ny) + y * nx + x;\n}\n\nvoid initializeGrid(std::vector<Real>& grid, const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {\n    for (size_t z = 0; z < nz; ++z)\n        for (size_t y = 0; y < ny; ++y)\n            for (size_t x = 0; x < nx; ++x) {\n                const size_t idx = idx3(x, y, z, nx, ny);\n                grid[idx] = (idx % 19) * 1.0;\n            }\n}\n\nvoid stencilIteration(const std::vector<Real>& input, std::vector<Real>& output,\n                      const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {\n    for (size_t z = 1; z < nz - 1; ++z)\n        for (size_t y = 1; y < ny - 1; ++y)\n            for (size_t x = 1; x < nx - 1; ++x) {\n                const size_t idx = idx3(x, y, z, nx, ny);\n                const Real center = input[idx];\n                const Real left = input[idx3(x-1, y, z, nx, ny)];\n                const Real right = input[idx3(x+1, y, z, nx, ny)];\n                const Real front = input[idx3(x, y-1, z, nx, ny)];\n                const Real back = input[idx3(x, y+1, z, nx, ny)];\n                const Real bottom = input[idx3(x, y, z-1, nx, ny)];\n                const Real top = input[idx3(x, y, z+1, nx, ny)];\n                output[idx] = (center + left + right + front + back + bottom + top) / 7.0;\n            }\n    for (size_t z = 0; z < nz; ++z)\n        for (size_t y = 0; y < ny; ++y)\n            for (size_t x = 0; x < nx; ++x)\n                if (x == 0 || x == nx-1 || y == 0 || y == ny-1 || z == 0 || z == nz-1) {\n                    const size_t idx = idx3(x, y, z, nx, ny);\n                    output[idx] = input[idx];\n                }\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    size_t nx = 128, ny = 0, nz = 0;\n    int iterations = 10;\n    bool printResults = false;\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-x\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) nx = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-y\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) ny = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-z\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) nz = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-i\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) iterations = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) printResults = true;\n    }\n    if (ny == 0) ny = nx;\n    if (nz == 0) nz = nx;\n    size_t gridSize = nx * ny * nz;\n    std::vector<Real> grid1(gridSize), grid2(gridSize);\n    initializeGrid(grid1, nx, ny, nz);\n    for (int iter = 0; iter < iterations; ++iter) {\n        if (iter % 2 == 0) stencilIteration(grid1, grid2, nx, ny, nz);\n        else stencilIteration(grid2, grid1, nx, ny, nz);\n    }\n    const std::vector<Real>& finalGrid = (iterations % 2 == 0) ? grid1 : grid2;\n    if (printResults) print_results(finalGrid, \"Grid\");\n    return 0;\n}\n"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/run/llm-eval/state/tmp/opencode/orig/stencil3d/stencil3d.cpp","exists":false,"truncated":false},"title":"run/llm-eval/state/tmp/opencode/orig/stencil3d/stencil3d.cpp","time":{"start":1793060294379,"end":1793060294405}},"metadata":{"anthropic":{"caller":{"type":"direct"}}},"id":"prt_17ab8c344001fPO4cDOCMcp5rS","sessionID":"ses_e8548239cffes90HT8MftQy6mQ","messageID":"msg_17ab8b69e001DBy89zsNSHAC0t"}}
